about_the_game:
In order to enjoy the content included in the Expansion Subscription you will need to own Cities: Skylines base game.

Elevate your city-building experience with all that Cities: Skylines has to offer. Explore new urban development by getting access to all expansions; from eco-friendly buildings, new public transportation networks, industrial supply chains and much much more.

The Cities: Skylines Expansion Subscription includes:

Expansions:
Get immediate access to a vast array of content including top sellers such as “Industries” and “Mass Transit” and the additional challenges in "Natural Disasters."

Content Creator Packs:
Explore the big variety of content packs created by some of Cities: Skylines most talented community modders and artists. Make your city unique with a variety of special themed buildings, vehicles and maps!

Radio stations:
Included is a diverse array of radio stations featuring music styles like classical, rock, and pop. Whatever you need to be in the perfect city building mood.

Full Access:
Access all current and the future content developed for Cities: Skylines.
